title: Research Analysts’ Downgrades for November, 2nd (AAPL, ACLS, ADVM, AMRN, BLL, BURL, CARB, CC, CRI, ECA)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Nov 2nd, 2018 // No Comments
Research Analysts’ downgrades for Friday, November 2nd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by analysts at Bank of America Corp from a buy rating to a neutral rating. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Axcelis Technologies (NASDAQ:ACLS) was downgraded by analysts at Benchmark Co. from a buy rating to a hold rating.
Adverum Biotechnologies (NASDAQ:ADVM) was downgraded by analysts at SunTrust Banks, Inc. from a buy rating to a hold rating.
Adverum Biotechnologies (NASDAQ:ADVM) was downgraded by analysts at Raymond James to a hold rating.
Amarin (NASDAQ:AMRN) was downgraded by analysts at Citigroup Inc from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
Ball (NYSE:BLL) was downgraded by analysts at Vertical Group from a buy rating to a hold rating.
Burlington Stores (NYSE:BURL) was downgraded by analysts at Wedbush from an outperform rating to a neutral rating.
Carbonite (NASDAQ:CARB) was downgraded by analysts at med from an outperform rating to a market perform rating.
Chemours (NYSE:CC) was downgraded by analysts at Citigroup Inc from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
Carter’s (NYSE:CRI) was downgraded by analysts at Macquarie from an outperform rating to a neutral rating.
Encana (NYSE:ECA) (TSE:ECA) was downgraded by analysts at BMO Capital Markets from an outperform rating to a market perform rating.
Encana (NYSE:ECA) (TSE:ECA) was downgraded by analysts at Desjardins from a buy rating to a hold rating.
Encana (NYSE:ECA) (TSE:ECA) was downgraded by analysts at Raymond James from a strong-buy rating to an outperform rating.
Emerald Expositions Events (NYSE:EEX) was downgraded by analysts at Citigroup Inc from a neutral rating to a sell rating.
Essex Property Trust (NYSE:ESS) was downgraded by analysts at BMO Capital Markets to a market perform rating.
Huntington Bancshares (NASDAQ:HBAN) was downgraded by analysts at Wedbush from an outperform rating to a neutral rating. They currently have $18.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $16.00.
Hi-Crush Partners (NYSE:HCLP) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an equal weight rating to a sell rating. Barclays PLC currently has $5.00 price target on the stock.
Installed Building Products (NYSE:IBP) was downgraded by analysts at Seaport Global Securities from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
Independence Realty Trust (NYSE:IRT) was downgraded by analysts at Compass Point from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
Gartner (NYSE:IT) was downgraded by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies from a neutral rating to an underweight rating.
Kraft Heinz (NASDAQ:KHC) was downgraded by analysts at UBS Group AG to a neutral rating.
L3 Technologies (NYSE:LLL) was downgraded by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. from an overweight rating to a neutral rating.
Allscripts Healthcare Solutions (NASDAQ:MDRX) was downgraded by analysts at SunTrust Banks, Inc. from a buy rating to a hold rating.
Allscripts Healthcare Solutions (NASDAQ:MDRX) was downgraded by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. from an overweight rating to a hold rating. The firm currently has $12.00 price target on the stock.
Newfield Exploration (NYSE:NFX) was downgraded by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada to a hold rating.
Newfield Exploration (NYSE:NFX) was downgraded by analysts at UBS Group AG from a positive rating to a neutral rating.
Intellia Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NTLA) was downgraded by analysts at Wedbush from an outperform rating to a neutral rating.
ORBCOMM (NASDAQ:ORBC) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a sell rating. According to Zacks, “ORBCOMM INC., is a leading global satellite data communications company, focused on Machine-to-Machine communications. Its customers include General Electric, Caterpillar Inc., Volvo Group and Komatsu Ltd. among other industry leaders. By means of a global network of twenty nine low-earth orbit satellites and accompanying ground infrastructure, ORBCOMM’s low-cost and reliable two-way data communications products and services track, monitor and control mobile and fixed assets in four core markets: commercial transportation; heavy equipment; industrial fixed assets; and marine/homeland security. The company’s products are installed on trucks, containers, marine vessels, locomotives, backhoes, pipelines, oil wells, utility meters, storage tanks and other assets. ORBCOMM is headquartered in Fort Lee, New Jersey and has a Network Control Center in Dulles, Virginia. “
PBF Logistics (NYSE:PBFX) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a buy rating to a hold rating. According to Zacks, “PBF Logistics LP engages in owning, leasing, operating, developing and acquiring crude oil and refined petroleum products terminals, pipelines, storage facilities and similar logistics assets. PBF Logistics LP is headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey. “
Puma Biotechnology (NASDAQ:PBYI) was downgraded by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. from an overweight rating to a sell rating. The firm currently has $23.00 price target on the stock.
Puma Biotechnology (NASDAQ:PBYI) was downgraded by analysts at Barclays PLC from an equal weight rating to an underweight rating.
Peapack-Gladstone Financial (NASDAQ:PGC) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a sell rating. According to Zacks, “The Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation is a bank holding company for Peapack-Gladstone Bank. The Bank is primarily dedicated to providing quality, personalized financial, trust and investment services to individuals and small businesses. “
PerkinElmer (NYSE:PKI) was downgraded by analysts at Janney Montgomery Scott from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
PennantPark Investment (NASDAQ:PNNT) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a sell rating. According to Zacks, “PennantPark Investment Corporation is a business development company which principally invests in U.S. middle-market private companies in the form of mezzanine debt, senior secured loans and equity investments. The companies in which it invests are typically highly leveraged, often as a result of leveraged buy-outs or other recapitalization transactions. PennantPark’s investment objectives are to generate both current income and capital appreciation through debt and equity investments. PennantPark Investment Corporation is managed by PennantPark Investment Advisers, LLC. “
Proto Labs (NYSE:PRLB) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a buy rating to a hold rating. According to Zacks, “Proto Labs, Inc. is an online and technology-enabled quick-turn manufacturer of custom parts for prototyping and short-run production. It produces CNC machined and injection molded plastic parts. Proto Labs targets their services to product developers who use three-dimensional computer-aided design to develop products across a diverse range of end-markets. The Company has locations in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, Italy, France, and Spain. Proto Labs, Inc. is headquartered in Maple Plain, Minnesota. “
Palatin Technologies (NYSEAMERICAN:PTN) was downgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a buy rating to a hold rating. According to Zacks, “Palatin Technologies, Inc is a development-stage medical technology company involved in developing and commercializing products and technologies for diagnostic imaging, cancer therapy and ethical drug development These developments are based on its proprietary monoclonal antibody radiolabeling and enabling peptide platform technologies. “
Royal Gold (NASDAQ:RGLD) (TSE:RGL) was downgraded by analysts at TD Securities from a buy rating to a hold rating.
Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) was downgraded by analysts at Stephens from an equal weight rating to an underweight rating.
Terex (NYSE:TEX) was downgraded by analysts at Vertical Research from a buy rating to a hold rating.
United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) was downgraded by analysts at Citigroup Inc from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) was downgraded by analysts at Citigroup Inc from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
Ventas (NYSE:VTR) was downgraded by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada from an outperform rating to a sector perform rating.
